note: Parquet = a per-column-chunk RLE_DICTIONARY page (dedupes identical values, ZSTD-framed). EKBLOOM m9 = one 540 B shared order-0 dictionary per file + a header-less core per value (amortised). zstd-dict = zstd.BuildDict trained on the same records, dictionary bytes amortised. Read p50 and allocs/op are the median across R = EKB_RUNS runs (default 5; 3 in CI) with min/max retained: EKBLOOM DecodeRecord per value vs. reading the full Parquet column into []string (which includes opening the file). Sizes (parquet bytes, m9 payload, dictionary bytes) are deterministic.
